tells.1: 'I found myself doing the usual things' is a stock filler opener, and it sits alongside the balanced 'Some lessons had gone beautifully; others...' antithesis and the tidy closing line.
tells.2: Polished, generic reflection with symmetrical contrasts ('Some... others...', 'I was ready to go, but...') and no concrete names or moments.
tells.3: None. Its weakness is slight clunkiness ('where they ended up', 'which has always gone well'), not an AI tell.
tells.4: The same symmetrical contrast structure and neat bow-tied ending as 2, only lightly varied by splitting the semicolon sentence.

reason: Version 3 has specific, checkable details (Amina Yusuf, period 4 AP Chem, the elephant toothpaste demo) and an unflattering admission ('relieved as much as sad, which is a little embarrassing'), which make it credible and human. Versions 1, 2 and 4 are near-identical, smoothly generic reflections built on balanced antitheses.
